meta.name: captain-sync-all
meta.description: Captain-only. Fetch, merge origin into master, merge unique worktree work into master, and sync all worktrees. The daily rhythm command. NEVER pushes to remote. NEVER rebases. NEVER resets to origin. Formerly `/sync-all` — v2 rename to captain-actor-verb.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动同步多个 git 工作树到最新代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天要手动合并多个工作树的分支
copy.tagline_en: Automatically sync multiple git worktrees to latest code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually merge multiple worktrees daily

howto.what: 执行此技能后，Claude 会拉取远程仓库更新，合并 origin/master 到本地 master，然后将各工作树分支的提交（需您确认）合并到 master，最后同步所有工作树到新的 master。不会推送、变基或重置到 origin。
howto.when: 在 PR 合并后自动触发（作为步骤5），或当您完成迭代、阶段、计划等工作后手动输入 /captain-sync-all，或在新的会话开始时使用。

say.note: 执行每日同步，拉取远程并合并工作树。
确保 master 最新，所有工作树同步。

say.text: 合并所有工作树的工作到 master，/captain-sync-all

howto.what_en: On invocation, Claude fetches remote, merges origin/master into local master, then merges commits from each worktree branch into master (with confirmation), and finally syncs all worktrees to the updated master. Never pushes, rebases, or resets to origin.
howto.when_en: Auto-triggered after a PR merge (as step 5), or manually after completing iteration/phase/plan milestones, or at session start to catch overnight drift.

say_en.note: Runs daily sync: fetch, merge origin, merge worktree work, sync worktrees.
Ensures master is up-to-date and all worktrees synced.

say_en.text: Merge all worktree work into master via /captain-sync-all
say_en.note: Claude asks confirmation for each worktree.
